The '''Galactic Wildlife Liberation Front''' was an organization operating around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] that sought freedom and safety for non-sentient wildlife. They posted a bounty on [[Mawshunba Zee]], a member of [[Sebolto's drug cartel]], for the illegal breeding of wild [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. This bounty was claimed, alive, by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
